newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy April crude oil - traders.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy April crude oil - traders.

text.p: India's state-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has tendered to buy one million barrels of April loading crude oil, traders said on Monday.
The tender closes at 0800 hours New Delhi time February 27 and offers should be valid until 2200 hours on February 28.
The tender seeks a wide range of crude oil, including Middle East, West African, Asian and North Sea grades.
In its March tender, India took three cargoes of Dubai crude, two very large crude carriers (VLCC) of Qua Iboe and one VLCC of Palanca.
